where_669_comes_from: 669 = the ORIGINAL TRAINING split only (635 patients). It was never the total: the brief of the experimental phase listed 'Total labelled ECGs: 669', which was corrected in the phase-1 report. Total labelled = 1,047 (993 patients) = train 669 + validation 168 + test 210.
patient_identifier: manifest column 'patient' = anonymous hash created by the original project from the patient name in the file name; grouping therefore assumes consistent name spelling across visits (cannot be verified without reading names, which this work does not do).
